note: The ONLY place a T-LDM threshold is defined. scripts/test_all.py fails if a config or the trainer disagrees. A head is published only if it reaches acceptance_heldout on BOTH never-trained-on sets; degenerate_floor additionally blocks the all-UNK / pwd failure.
decision_rule: The publish rule compares the cycle's point score with acceptance_heldout. gate/stats.py gives the 95% Wilson interval (pass / fail / inconclusive) to say how sure a score on 12-14 tasks is; it is for reporting, not for publishing.
